title: Aivu, son of Rav
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Pesachim 113a. His father said to him, “I see that you are not succeeding in your studies. Come, I will teach you worldly matters,” and taught him the ways of commerce.[^1][^2]

notes.text: His father is the speaker who offers to teach him worldly matters and then teaches him commerce.

William Davidson Pesachim 113a explicitly has Rav addressing Aivu, his son, offering worldly instruction and giving commercial advice. The quotation in the translation renders Hyman’s Hebrew retelling; it is not a claim to reproduce the digital Talmud’s wording verbatim. The father remains the speaker and teacher.
